I'd like to share my personal experience in case it's helpful for men facing the same problem.
I've had "premature ejaculation" for quite some time, affecting both my self-confidence and relationships.
Initially, I tried to solve it myself:
Taking medication → Had to take it before every sexual encounter, it was tiring and I didn't want to rely on it forever.
Applying creams → Sometimes it was too numbing, sometimes it didn't help at all, and ultimately, the symptoms didn't improve.
At some point, I started seriously researching medical treatments.
I learned that premature ejaculation can be divided into two groups:
Temporary, which addresses the symptoms, such as medication or creams.
Long-term, which addresses the root cause, such as sensitivity to trigger points, the nervous system, or structural issues.
I live in Chiang Mai, so I focused on clinics specializing in premature ejaculation in the area.
There are several well-known clinics (I won't mention names). I spent a considerable amount of time researching them.
Finally, I narrowed it down to 3 clinics with urologists who oversee the treatment.
What made me choose this clinic was their straightforward explanation.
The doctor examined and took a detailed history to understand the cause of my premature ejaculation.
In my case, it was related to heightened sensitivity in the glans.
The treatment plan the doctor recommended... This is a treatment for premature ejaculation using targeted fillers.
The goal is to adjust sensitivity; it doesn't numb the area or affect erection.
Before the procedure, the steps, advantages, limitations, and expected results were clearly explained.
On the day of the procedure, it didn't take long and wasn't as scary as I thought.
After the procedure, I started to see a clear difference.
I had better control over the rhythm, and the sensation remained normal. I didn't need to rely on medication again.
What impressed me most was the post-treatment care.
There was real follow-up; it wasn't just a one-off treatment.
The doctor checked on my condition and provided advice throughout, which made me feel reassured.
